messages:
sam-oliver: Acme-Corp CS — intermittent 503s + client timeouts on hosted streaming generate for the past ~2h. They say SDK enters a retry loop and sees duplicate billing hits. Happening from multiple regions. Can someone triage?
acme-cs: FYI logs. Using our JS SDK v2.3.1. Pattern: streaming call stalls ~15-30s then `503` with `upstream reset`. Example (redacted):
```js
const stream = client.chat.stream({ model: 'open-beta/large', input: '...' })
stream.on('error', err => console.error(err))
// error: HttpError 503: upstream response 503, connection closed
```
Also seeing `ECONNRESET` on client and repeated automatic retries (default sdk backoff) which worsened user experience.
julia-chen: Thanks. Two quick asks: 1) sample curl request + response headers? 2) can you confirm region & model id and whether they used streaming chunk size / keepalive settings?
acme-cs: curl shows `x-request-id: req_7f3a` and `x-region: us-west-2`. Model pinned to `rwdx-v1-large`. They send messages ~500 tokens initial then stream. No custom keepalive in their app.
maria-gomez: Any infra deploys in the last 3 hours? Any config changes to edge proxies or auth token rotation?
deploy-bot: rollback completed: edge-proxy v3.2.1 -> v3.2.0 at 1767450500 due to perf regressions.
julia-chen: ok rollback may explain instability. I'll try to repro from us-west-2 with the same model + sdk 2.3.1. Can you paste the full response headers around the 503? especially `via`, `x-upstream`, `x-retry-after` if present.
acme-cs: headers: `via: edge-proxy`, `x-upstream: inference-node-12`, `server: redwood`, no `retry-after`. Full: 
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Date: Tue, 12 Mar 2026 14:12:03 GMT
Via: edge-proxy
X-Upstream: inference-node-12
X-Request-Id: req_7f3a
Content-Type: text/plain
```
sam-oliver: Good find. @julia-chen could this be an upstream inference worker OOM / overload? If rollback started ~1h before errors, maybe transient routing to older edge variant caused queue/backpressure.
julia-chen: Repro notes: hitting the same model with streaming from us-west-2 I see a ~25s stall then a `503` with `x-upstream: inference-node-12`. I can reproduce locally with repeated concurrent streams (50 connections) — p95 failure. Logs show kvcache lock waits and `gateway: connection aborted`.
maria-gomez: Put mitigation: 1) increase per-node concurrency cap for rwdx-v1-large on Dedicated pool temporarily; 2) apply circuit-breaker at edge to return 429 earlier instead of 503 under overload; 3) advise customer to disable aggressive client-side retries for streaming (set retry_count=0) to avoid duplicate billing.
sam-oliver: I told Acme to set SDK retry_count=0 and we'll route them to eu fallback for now. They agreed to the temporary change.
julia-chen: I'll open runtime ticket and share repro steps: `ab -n 200 -c 50` style stream clients hitting model endpoint with persistent http2 keepalive. Assigning to eng-runtime: ticket RT-8241.
sam-oliver: CS update going out: "We're investigating intermittent 503s affecting streaming; temporary mitigation applied (client retry off + routing fallback). We'll follow up when eng-runtime confirms root cause." :thumbsup:
acme-cs: thanks, appreciate quick response. Please keep us posted.
julia-chen: Next actions: eng-runtime will collect kv-cache locks, node memory graphs, and trace `req_7f3a` path. If we confirm overload due to edge rollback, we'll redeploy stable build and throttle ingress. ETA for initial root-cause details 2 hours.
sam-oliver: tagging follow-up reminder for 2h and customer comms. Closing interim loop.
